card.profile: Circle dance, or chain dance, is a style of social dance done in a circle, semicircle or a curved line to musical accompaniment, such as rhythm instruments and singing, and is a type of dance where anyone can join in without the need of partners. Unlike line dancing, circle dancers are in physical contact with each other; the connection is made by hand-to-hand, finger-to-finger or hands-on-shoulders, where they follow the leader around the dance floor. Ranging from gentle to energetic, the dance can be an uplifting group experience or part of a meditation.
card.insight: Derived from a medieval ring dance, and surviving only in the Faroes, it is danced traditionally in a circle, but when a lot of people take part in the dance they usually let it swing around in various wobbles within the circle.

card.sacred_note: Some forms, such as Sufi whirling (sama) and certain ritual circle dances, are considered sacred or meditative, intended for religious worship or spiritual focus.
